tulyakālamanuprāptaiḥ sahasrendu na
kiṃ nabhaḥ iti praśnasyottaraṃ tatra prathamaṃ śrāvayati - phale ityādinā

anyasaṃkalpapuramanyaḥ prāpnotītyetatkveva kutra
dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtya prakṛte śaṅkyate

tajjantau tasmin saṃkalpayitṛjīve eva
na pare jīvāntare dṛṣṭā
asminneva candre te sarve lāghavātkuto na praviṣṭāstatrāha - ahamiti

taistu na tathā
dhyātaṃ kiṃtu tvatpraśnānusārātkhe syāmakṣayapūrṇenduriti kāmanayā dhyātamiti
bhāvaḥ
anyathādhyāne'nyathāphalaṃ kuto na bhavati tatrāha - yatheti

yathāyaṃ
svabhāvamayamanusaṃdhatte dṛḍhasaṃkalpena dhyāyati taṃ svabhāvamavyayā
sākṣisaṃvittathaivānubhavati na vaiparītyenetyarthaḥ

jāyātvena samaṃ kālam iti
praśno'pyanenaiva yuktyā samādheya ityatidiśati - yatheti

sādhvyasādhvī gṛhe bhartuḥ saṃsthitā tapasā parā iti praśnāṃśe'pyayameva
samādhirityāha - yeti

yadā idamasmadādidṛśyaṃ jagadapi samastamādyasya jñajanmana
autpattikasārvajñyavato hiraṇyagarbhasya kalpanāmātraṃ tadā teṣu upāsakakalpitajagatsu
kimanyathā anyādṛśaṃ satyaṃ syādyenāsamañjasatā syādityarthaḥ

manojñānendriyairvedanāvedanākārā bhrāntistayā bhrāntyā viṣayaprāptaye
taccinmātraṃ samanaskaiḥ karmendriyaiḥ spandāspandātma saṃpadyate

ito dānādadānādvā akṛtrimaḥ saṃkalpa eva dānaphalaṃ bhogaiśvaryādi adānaphalaṃ
dāridryādi vā paraloke'stu na kaścidvirodha iti sarvāsamañjasaparihāra ityarthaḥ

sarvānpraśnānkaṇṭhato'rthācca samādhāya jagato brahmaiva tattvamityupasaṃharati -
etaditi

dehe eva cidabhivyaktidarśanādanabhivyaktaciti bhrāntyādyadarśanātsargādau
bhrāntisiddhau dehasiddhistatsiddhyā ca bhrāntisiddhirityanyonyāśrayaṃ manyamāno rājā
pṛcchati - sargādāviti

cinmātraṃ dehaśūnyaṃ caitanyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ
dehakalpanaṃ kathaṃ bhāti

brahma tu sarvajñatvātsadaivābhivyaktacaitanyaṃ dehādi sarvaṃ
kalpayatītyaśayenottaramāha - tvayetyādinā

ambvambhasoriveti śabdadvayānukaraṇatvānna virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām
ityekaśeṣo'sahaprayogo'dvandvo vā

nanu svapne'pyasya nyāyasya sāmyādbrahmatve
svapnābha iti bhedaṃ siddhavatkṛtya dṛṣṭāntoktiḥ kathaṃ tatrāha - tvadbodhāyeti

svapnalakṣaṇena bhasmanā
bādhitārthena saha cidātmā ābhāte sarge sādṛśyaṃ na tvastītyarthaḥ

tathā ca kadāpi
jāgratsvapnādi yathā no nāstyeva tathā atyacchaṃ brahmāsti
sphaṭikaśilāyā ābaddhaṃ ghanaṃ yadudaraṃ madhyaṃ tadupamam
arthināṃ puruṣārthecchūnāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ purata iti śeṣaḥ

tathā ca saditi
vedādisiddhaṃ brahma tathaivābhyupagantavyam asaditi siddhaṃ dvaitaṃ
tathaivābhyupagantavyamityarthaḥ
yadā tena caramasākṣātkāravṛttirūpeṇa jñānena samaṃ sthitameva vilīyate tadā

tvayārtho dehaśabdasyetyādinā etadantena maduktena nyāyena sajīvanmuktatvaṃ
jīvanmuktisahitaṃ lokavedādi sarvaṃ jagadetadbrahmaiva sidhyati tasmādeṣa eva madukto
nyāyaḥ paramapuruṣārthopāyatvādupādātumucita ityarthaḥ

asmin aparijñātātmamātrarūpasaṃsāralakṣaṇe pādape'śvatthavṛkṣe parijñātaṃ
cidākāśameva na tato'nyadaṇumātramapyasti saḥ aparijñātaḥ parijñātaśca
cidākāśo'hameva trijagat bandho mokṣaśca paryāyeṇeti vinirṇaya ityarthaḥ

loke jīvanmuktajane yatsiddhaṃ vicāraśataiḥ pariniṣṭhitaṃ tadeva svānubhavenāpi
saṃvedyate

tatprāptāvitarārthamātratyāgena tadekaniṣṭhataivopāyastena vāvaśyaṃ tatprāpyata
ityāha - sakalārtheti
sarvatra laukike'pi kārye anyadapi bhāvitaṃ tathaivetyarthaḥ

tatra laukikakāryamasatyaṃ mokṣākhyaṃ tu satyamityavāntaravailakṣaṇyamastu nāma
sādhanodyogatatphalānubhave ca na viśeṣa ityāśayenāha - yatheti
